rules.name: SRTT domain cardinality
rules.requirement: Fixed source_entry_state=REVOKED and exactly 2304 variable tuples.

rules.name: SRTT tuple uniqueness
rules.requirement: Exactly one row per declared variable tuple; no duplicate input tuple; row_id values are exactly the unique contiguous set 1..2304.

rules.name: SRTT decisive rule membership
rules.requirement: RuleRegistry contains exactly SRTT15-R01..R11 once each with unique contiguous precedence 1..11; outside-table rule is exactly SRTT15-R00; every table-row decisive_rule_id resolves to exactly one frozen rule.

rules.name: SRTT full semantic recomputation
rules.requirement: Recompute every row under frozen SRTT-4 precedence and require exact result/rule match.

rules.name: Guard identity
rules.requirement: Unique contiguous G001..G156; one ACTIVE record each.

rules.name: Case identity and guard references
rules.requirement: Unique case IDs; every positive/negative guard case exists; zero declared conflicts.

rules.name: Guard omission evidence recomputation
rules.requirement: For 11 embedded source excerpts recompute SHA-256 under declared basis, expand ranges, and require exact guard/case set equality.

rules.name: BSP structural authority
rules.requirement: Exactly one version-15 current-status block; semantic-test sections paired, non-nested, non-empty and ID-consistent; markers only standalone outside fences.

rules.name: Dependency graph closure
rules.requirement: All endpoints declared, no duplicate edge, acyclic, direct-edge semantics only.

rules.name: Evaluation order monotonicity
rules.requirement: No later stage consumes unqualified state or converts earlier blocker to authority without governed successor/recovery event.

rules.name: MTR authority freshness
rules.requirement: Live challenge exact-context match; single acceptance; <=30s verifier-monotonic age; no stale-token fallback.

rules.name: Canonical identity/quorum
rules.requirement: Alias-collapsed canonical subjects; only ACTIVE identities count; domain diversity cannot be manufactured by alias. Authority-bearing identifiers must resolve as exact stable canonical IDs under the owning registry/source contract; display aliases cannot substitute.

rules.name: Revocation temporal validity
rules.requirement: Current committed revocation state; UNREVOKE cannot validate prior revoked interval.

rules.name: AIEP authority profile
rules.requirement: Authority evaluator must be attested broker-only profile; UNATTESTED_RUNTIME cannot exercise authority roles.

rules.name: AIM Smax before permission/lifecycle filtering
rules.requirement: AIM candidate scope uses the exact nine-component canonical scope tuple; stored specificity equals exact non-ANY component count; compute AIM_Smax over the full effective matching set before permission/lifecycle filtering; at AIM_Smax every ANY component must be explicitly allowed for that semantic_class by the current ACTIVE AIMScopePolicy; AIMScopePolicy semantic_class keys are unique; project/org/experiment policy cannot broaden AIM permission; source-lineage/policy/class/scope changes require a constitutionally linked successor; invalid/missing/narrowed/revoked policy blocks lower fallback.

rules.name: RIR exact temporal tuple
rules.requirement: Exactly one temporally eligible ACTIVE RIR tuple matching policy, implementation, runtime, workload and suite.

rules.name: RCS freshness
rules.requirement: Only current PASS for the exact bound RIR/policy/implementation/runtime/workload/RCS-1 tuple; the RCS-1 suite digest must bind suite/version, vector manifest, vector generator, generator runtime, input corpus, expected-result manifest, execution harness, required resolver runtime/workload identities and result schema. Stale/failed/expired/unavailable evidence cannot qualify or fall back.

rules.name: Semantic Smax and ANY
rules.requirement: Semantic candidates use the exact nine-component canonical scope tuple; stored specificity equals exact non-ANY count; semantic_entry_key equals the canonical digest of semantic_input_id+semantic_lineage_id+semantic_version+scope_tuple; compute semantic Smax before lifecycle filtering; every ANY component must be allowed by the current ACTIVE ANYScopePermission for the semantic_class; permission drift/absence/conflict blocks with no lower fallback.

rules.name: Multi-revoked composition
rules.requirement: Every revoked Smax blocker uniquely discharges only through an explicitly linked ACTIVE successor or constitutional lineage/scope mapping; mapping source/destination entries and scope tuples must match; partial discharge never grants authority; final SREP comparison is set-based and order-independent.

rules.name: Authority read-set sealing
rules.requirement: Every mutable authority input is registered, captured, bound into DPS and final seal; DecisionPresealContext uses explicit effect_class=null exactly for non-effect decisions and a non-empty governed effect class for external-effect decisions; state change before commit => STATE_CHANGED and no effect intent.

rules.name: Qualified time proof
rules.requirement: Single-use 256-bit nonce, same DPS digest, source validity at sequence, at least 2 distinct qualified sources of reference population 3; no local-clock/cached/weaker fallback.

rules.name: Effect success boundary
rules.requirement: Only SUCCEEDED_RECONCILED is success; that state requires non-null qualified executor identity evidence plus non-null provider-specific reconciliation evidence; ambiguous/unverified provider outcomes are never success; retries reuse the frozen idempotency key.

rules.name: Evidence strength
rules.requirement: Strong evidence requires qualified producer/runtime and exact derivation; rewrapping cannot upgrade class; missing/contradictory mandatory evidence blocks.

rules.name: Migration authority boundary
rules.requirement: Stable constitution+tenant+object identity; complete object map; fresh destination policy; widening requires fresh destination authorization; cross-constitution import carries no authority.

rules.name: Recovery anti-replay
rules.requirement: Predeclared trigger, current context, single-use nonce, lawful quorum/current trust; unavailable lawful path never creates weaker emergency root.

rules.name: No optional authority bypass
rules.requirement: Missing required authority field is validation failure, never default/fallback authority.

rules.name: T0 successor threshold and monotonicity
rules.requirement: Successor generation is exactly predecessor+1; lawful predecessor authorization is proven by the exact T0 successor reservation request/certificate and is not an invented T0SuccessorManifest field; predecessor authorization/MTR reservation/BTW consistency all bind the same successor; requires 4-of-5 ACTIVE EBA officers across at least 3 ACTIVE admin domains; a newly created/reactivated domain cannot sign the successor that creates/reactivates it.

rules.name: BTW rollback/equivocation
rules.requirement: Verification uses T0-pinned witness policy; accepted tree size/root cannot roll back; smaller tree or missing consistency proof rejects; same size with different root is BTW_EQUIVOCATION and freezes affected authority paths.

rules.name: GGS/LAS sequencer safety
rules.requirement: GGS and LAS use 3 replicas/2-of-3 ordinary majority; rollback-resistant term/vote/index/head state; stale replica non-voting; GGS atomically consumes namespace/bootstrap authorization and its GGSGenesisStateRoot recomputes exactly from barrier index, committed log prefix, namespace root, authorization root, idempotency root, configuration generation and prior certificate-chain digest; LAS atomically compare-and-advances non-commutative heads and preserves idempotency state; JOINT rotation requires both old and new majorities.

rules.name: Rotation barrier and STC
rules.requirement: ROTATION_PREPARE commits barrier B and freezes covered writes; every STC binds the exact ROTATION_PREPARE certificate digest and exact B snapshot/state root; LAS STC always binds semantic heads; GGS STC binds semantic heads exactly when the governed GGS operation consumes or initializes semantic state and may not caller-select omission; one barrier serves at most one lawful rotation; same rotation/config/STC retry is idempotent; changed retry is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; different rotation on reserved B is BARRIER_ALREADY_RESERVED; ABORT permanently closes B; contradictory valid reservations are STC_EQUIVOCATION.

rules.name: GCP canonicalization
rules.requirement: Canonical authority input/output obeys inherited GCP: absent != null; defaults applied only before digest; NFC keys; duplicate or post-NFC-colliding keys reject; unpaired surrogates/noncharacters reject; ordered arrays preserve order; set arrays canonical-sort and reject duplicates; signed-int64 rules; schema-declared extensions included in digest and cannot shadow standard/sys: fields. Every digest-bearing field is validated against its exact governing source or bound crypto profile; when a source explicitly fixes SHA-256 or another concrete encoding, malformed values reject before authority use. Generic opaque digest references must not be silently reinterpreted as a different algorithm.

rules.name: Review materiality and reviewer independence
rules.requirement: Every reviewer-visible semantic field relied on for decision is packet-bound; unknown reviewer influence defaults material; required human review binds exact candidate/snapshot/packet digest and is independent from proposer under canonical identity/domain rules; model/provider review cannot replace a required human constitutional channel.

rules.name: CSM coherent snapshot and current semantic sequence
rules.requirement: CSM-5 contains the canonical semantic entries, lineage mappings, scope replacement mappings, ANY permissions, AIM descriptors, AIMScopePolicy, canonical resolver_policy_ref and supporting heads/rules; canonical arrays use the frozen canonical ordering; updates are LAS-governed authority events; all named heads are read from one current LAS-derived semantic_state_sequence; LASAuthorityStateRoot state_root_digest equals SHA-256(GCP-1) of exactly the frozen flat v14 member set with no nested substitute or additional member; historical/caller-selected sequence has authority NONE.

rules.name: External root anti-self-grant boundary
rules.requirement: Ordinary platform software cannot mint, replace, roll back or weaken T0/EBA/MTR/BTW/workload-attestation roots; unavailable lawful trust may block permanently and never creates an emergency weaker root.

rules.name: SPM-1 semantic-element provenance
rules.requirement: Every semantic schema element has provenance; every source_ref_id resolves; no conflicting or non-authoritative-only provenance; artifact digest in each entry equals the bound schema artifact.

rules.name: Qualified SPG-1 generator binding
rules.requirement: Final freeze requires QUALIFIED SchemaProvenanceGenerator identity with exact generator artifact digest, non-null RuntimeManifest digest, workload-attestation policy/proof, active/non-revoked binding, and allowed input/output classes. UNATTESTED/DRIFTED/REVOKED/UNREGISTERED output is not final-freeze eligible.

rules.name: GCP-RVM-2 positive vectors
rules.requirement: Recompute SHA-256 over every frozen expected canonical UTF-8 byte string and require exact digest match. GCP-RVM2-P05 is governed by R8-V15-R1-GCP-P05-SEMANTIC-SUCCESSOR and must preserve lexicographic NFC Unicode-scalar object-key order.

rules.name: GCP-RVM-2 rejection vectors
rules.requirement: Every frozen rejection vector must fail under its referenced GCP rule; no canonical output or authority may be produced for a rejection vector.

rules.name: CaseProofContract closure G001-G156
rules.requirement: Exactly one CaseProofContract per G001..G156; mechanism, positive cases, negative cases and FP class must exactly match current GuardRegistry and CaseRegistry; no missing or extra case.

rules.name: Fault-proof class legend integrity
rules.requirement: FP0..FP6 meanings are frozen exactly; required negative control evidence cannot be downgraded or substituted by target-guard outcome.

rules.name: RPS-1 field classification coverage
rules.requirement: Every displayed review-packet field is classified REVIEW_SEMANTIC or DISPLAY_NON_SEMANTIC; unknown displayed fields default REVIEW_SEMANTIC.

rules.name: RPS-1 non-semantic safety
rules.requirement: DISPLAY_NON_SEMANTIC fields cannot encode status, severity, identity, evidence quality, ordering priority, recommendation or substantive claim and cannot alter packet ordering or evidence association.

rules.name: Freeze-process authoritative source boundary
rules.requirement: No schema element/freeze rule may be sourced only from PR #39/#40 or any NON_AUTHORITATIVE artifact; every manual/generated element has governed source lineage.

rules.name: Exact schema artifact digest binding
rules.requirement: Freeze manifest, SPM-1, generator output record and independent-review packet must bind the identical schema artifact SHA-256 bytes; byte drift invalidates prior review/provenance.

rules.name: Independent executable-schema review
rules.requirement: The exact qualified schema candidate must receive a fresh qualifying blind independent review before status can become EXECUTABLE_SCHEMA_FROZEN. Review of a predecessor/different digest does not transfer.

freeze_readiness_rule: Final freeze requires SFV-01..SFV-45 PASS; SCHEMA_FREEZE_BLOCKED is not a PASS and grants no implementation authority.
